title: Simulacra Test Debate
prompt: Should a small research team build an AI simulation harness that models agent personalities and interruptions before adding domain-specific workflows?
success_criteria: Specific recommendation, clear tradeoffs, preserved dissent, and a runnable next step.

output_format.description: Final synthesis must be a compact PRD in Markdown. Include: product idea, target user, problem, proposed solution, core user flow, MVP scope, out of scope, agent/personality mechanics if relevant, risks, open questions, and immediate build plan. Preserve any unresolved dissent briefly.

variables.decision_pressure: The team wants a prototype direction today.
variables.shared_goal: Converge on one concrete hackathon project idea and then produce a useful PRD for building it.
